description: Splits a polyphonic pitch CV into whole semitones and the leftover fraction, so a plug-in in Host can play microtonal scales.

inputs.text: The polyphonic pitch to be split; every channel patched in is carried through to both outputs.

outputs.text: The pitch rounded down to the nearest whole semitone, one channel per channel of the input.
The part of the pitch above that whole semitone, as 0-5V per channel; set the plug-in's pitch bend range to one half step.

notes: it sends no MIDI of its own: patch its two outputs into a Host module's CV and pitch bend inputs, then set the hosted plug-in's pitch bend range to one half step either way.
